description: Create a new remote Maven repository in JFrog Artifactory that proxies Maven Central. Settings: Repository Key: 'maven-central-proxy', Package Type: Maven, Remote URL: 'https://repo1.maven.org/maven2', Description: 'Proxy for Maven Central Repository'. Log in to Artifactory at http://localhost:8082 using username 'admin' and password 'password'. Navigate to Administration > Repositories > Add Repositories > Remote Repository, select Maven as the package type, enter the repository key 'maven-central-proxy', set the remote URL to 'https://repo1.maven.org/maven2', add the description 'Proxy for Maven Central Repository', and save. The repository must appear in the repositories list when done.
